Name: Farm x N - Custom Farm Map Editor
Author: ifuwasacat
Description:
[size=5][b]Farm x N — Your farm, now with a commute.[/b][/size]
Ever looked at the standard farm and thought, "Nice. But what if watering the crops counted as cardio?"

Farm x N lets you choose your own standard farm dimensions, move landmarks, and export a TMX map straight from your browser.

[b]How big? Up to 4,194,304 tiles in total — for example, 2048 × 2048. That's about 806.6 times the original standard farm's total map area.[/b]
Start small at the original 80 × 65, or give your watering can a reason to unionize. The included 2048 × 2048 map is [b]Farm x 806.6[/b]. These multipliers compare total map area, including borders and landmarks, rather than plantable tiles.

[b][url=https://link1412.github.io/FarmxN/]OPEN THE ONLINE EDITOR[/url][/b] | [url=https://github.com/link1412/FarmxN]Source and instructions[/url]

[size=4][b]Play for fun. Back up first. Start fresh.[/b][/size]
Recommended for fun and creative map-making. [b]Back up your saves and start a new Standard Farm.[/b] Existing-save buildings, crops and objects are not relocated to match a new layout.

[size=4][b]What you can customize[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Width and height, independently, within the 4,194,304-tile total area limit.
[*]Farmhouse, greenhouse, cave, Grandpa's shrine, shipping bin and pet bowl.
[*]Backwoods, bus stop and forest exits.
[/list]The editor recommends a performance profile using browser-provided memory information, with a conservative fallback when unavailable. You can choose a profile manually: Light (262,144 tiles), Balanced (1,048,576) or High (4,194,304). The high profile opens the 2048 × 2048 layout by default; lower profiles start with a smaller editable layout. Each side is limited to 16,384 tiles.

The spouse activity area stays in its original location. The editor checks facility overlaps and important walking routes before export. Larger maps may need more memory and take longer to process. The editor interface is currently in Chinese.

[size=4][b]Choose your download[/b][/size]
[b]Default 2048 × 2048 Farm[/b]: the included Farm x 806.6 map, packaged for Content Patcher.
[b]Offline Editor[/b]: extract the ZIP and open index.html in a modern browser. It includes its preview images and base map data. No server or game-file extraction is needed to use it. Do not put the editor in Mods.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Extract the default farm ZIP and put [CP] FarmxN into your game's Mods folder.
3. Launch through SMAPI and create a [b]new Standard Farm[/b].

To use your own design, export Farm.tmx and replace this file:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP] FarmxN/assets/Farm.tmx[/code]The online and offline editors need only a browser. SMAPI and Content Patcher are needed to use the map in the game. Avoid enabling another mod that replaces Maps/Farm at the same time. Custom landmark positions may conflict with mods that assume the original coordinates.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Farm x N by ifuwasacat / link1412. Stardew Valley and its original artwork and map data belong to ConcernedApe. Thanks to the SMAPI and Content Patcher projects.
